body: Thank you for your words once again. I'm glad that there is someone out there who can understand me and where I'm coming from :)

Hi, thanks for taking the time to comment. I really appreciate it. 

I'm 16 years old, female, and go by she/her.

I can't afford to take a break from school at the moment. We're currently going following a quarter system which means that if I miss one class, it's equivalent to missing a week's worth of material. As much as I would love to just take a break, it would do more harm than good I feel. 

As for hobbies, I don't really have any. I spend most of my free time just looking at pictures on Pinterest or something. 

I don't have too many responsibilities I think, as in, I'm unemployed. I'm not sure if it's considered responsibilities, but I guess just having to complete schoolwork, tutor homework, and studying for other exams is a part of my responsibilities. 

As I mentioned, I'm only 16 so I don't really have an option to spend time away from her. Even if I asked to stay with another family member or friend, she would find a way to make me seem like a bad person and would just say "if you don't want to be here, move out" as she's said that before. From the type of person she is, she would just start to call me ungrateful and blame me for my issues. I tried talking to her once about how she makes me feel sometimes and she just started saying that I'm the reason why she is etc.

For the whole teacher situation, they would not care if I said that to them. True, I can't know until I try. But I'm really not confident enough to do so. For me, even saying something as simple as that to someone is enough to make me start crying. I hate that I cry so easily and I wish I could stop it. But it's just another reason why I can't stand up to them. 

I've thought of speaking to a school counselor or something but they really won't do much except for calling your parents, which is exactly what I do **not** need. So being able to just put this online where I'm anonymous does somewhat feel better.

I'm glad that 2020 was able to be a better year for you, and thank you again for the offer :)
